data.one_liner: Local data engine providing key-value, SQL/NoSQL tables, vector embeddings, and hybrid text search.
data.what_it_does: ToStore is a local data engine supporting structured tables, key-value storage, vector embeddings, and full-text search. It offers cross-platform offline storage, ACID transactions, automatic schema evolution, encryption, and reactive queries.
use_when: Building local-first apps requiring complex queries, relations, and full-text or vector search.
Implementing on-device RAG or AI agent memory requiring hybrid retrieval and embeddings.
Needing an offline-capable database with encryption and multi-space data isolation.
avoid_when: You only need a simple, lightweight key-value store and prefer a smaller dependency footprint.
Your project relies purely on a cloud backend and does not require local persistence or vector searching.
strengths: Unified API combining structured tables, key-value, vector search, and full-text search.
Cross-platform support across mobile, desktop, and web.
Built-in data encryption and reactive query streams for local UI updates.
weaknesses: Relatively new package with a massive scope that may increase binary size or complexity.
Requires managing specific schema definitions and query configurations.
data.setup_notes: Add to pubspec.yaml and initialize via ToStore.open().

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a robust, type-safe SQLite database builder for Flutter without the specialized vector and hybrid search engines.

alternatives.name: hive_ce
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are looking for a fast, lightweight pure-Dart key-value and box database.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer traditional, raw SQLite access on mobile platforms.
